sources.description: Anthropic Agent Skills overview (fetched 2026-10-08): skills are filesystem-based resources; custom skills live in ~/.claude/skills/ or .claude/skills/ and do not require API uploads; custom skills do not sync across surfaces.

Anthropic Claude Code memory (fetched 2026-10-08): CLAUDE.md is plain markdown read at session start; each session begins with a fresh context window; auto memory is machine-local and files are not shared across machines or cloud environments; reading AGENTS.md directly requires Claude Code v2.1.277 or later.
Anthropic prompt caching (fetched 2026-10-08): default 5-minute cache lifetime; 5-minute cache write tokens are 1.25x base input price.
OpenAI Codex local configuration (fetched 2026-10-08): personal defaults in ~/.codex/config.toml with project overrides in .codex/config.toml.
OpenAI Codex Cloud (fetched 2026-10-08): tasks start from a published environment and each task has its own vendor-hosted workspace.

OpenAI prompt caching (fetched 2026-10-08): the cache stores KV tensors not tokens; reuse requires the entire rendered prefix to match; the cached context includes OpenAI-provided instructions and developer messages; GPT-5.6+ cache writes cost 1.25x the uncached input rate.
MCP specification index, revision 2025-06-18 (fetched 2026-10-08): authoritative protocol requirements based on the public TypeScript schema.
MCP server tools (fetched 2026-10-08): servers expose tools to models; discovery is a tools/list request.
MCP transports (fetched 2026-10-08): a session begins with the initialization phase; Streamable HTTP assigns a server-tracked Mcp-Session-Id.

Apple US store, Shop Mac Studio (fetched 2026-10-08): page-embedded price map lists four preconfigured amounts $2,499 / $3,099 / $5,499 / $6,799. Used only as a list-price band; the fetched markup does not evidence a price-to-CPU/GPU-configuration pairing.
